sources.name: Loveland Downtown Partnership
sources.notes: Checked 4 October 2026: Squarespace, and the calendar page embeds a Tockify calendar named "lovelanddowntown". Tockify's robots.txt disallows /api/, where its iCal feeds are served, for every agent, so no feed was read or is proposed; the signature-events page reads as plain HTML. Read by hand, or in a browser for the embedded calendar. Feed found 10 November 2026; the type stays html because this entry is confirmed and typing it ical would start ingest reading it. Tockify's subscription feed for the embedded calendar (https://tockify.com/api/feeds/ics/lovelanddowntown) was fetched once, under the published-subscription-feed exception, tockify.com's robots.txt still disallowing /api/ for every agent; it would need the editor's robots: subscribe. It answered 200 with 141 VEVENTs to 1 January 2027, each with a venue and street address, and it is a shared downtown calendar: Loveland Aleworks, Big Thompson Brewery, MeadKrieger, Artworks, the Rialto, desk chair workspace, Chapungu and the Historical Society all appear. 42 items are dated 10 November to 10 December 2026. Worth a row, about 18: Flip the Switch at Chapungu (13 November), the Artworks opening (13 November), six named music nights at Loveland Aleworks (13 to 28 November), the Friendsgiving potluck (15 November), Dr. Jackson Crawford at MeadKrieger (18 November), the Loveland Historical Society's November program (19 November, 6:30 pm, 503 N. Lincoln), the Festival of Lights (20 November, 5 pm), A Celtic Christmas at the Rialto (20 November, also in the Rialto's own feed), the bluegrass jam (22 November), Small Business Saturday at Artworks and at Aleworks (28 November), two workshops at Aleworks (28 and 29 November) and Brushes and Brews at Big Thompson Brewery (5 December). Regulars, about 22: weekly Live Jazz at 120 N. Lincoln Ave. (Tuesdays), bingo and music bingo at Big Thompson Brewery and Aleworks, trivia, two book clubs, the Bonsai Bar and MeadKrieger's Thursday barbecue. Never: a private retirement party and a members' networking hour. Suggested exclusions if it is turned on: Bingo, Trivia, Book Club, Live Jazz, Hot Off The Grill, Bonsai Bar, Retirement Party, dc Connect. It lists other organizers' events, so each item is the venue's, and the Rialto's would duplicate that venue's feed. Typed ical with robots: subscribe 10 November 2026 on the owner's word ("Go 1 to 3"): the Tockify feed in feedUrl is now what ingest reads. tockify.com's robots.txt disallows /api/, and this is the calendar the Partnership publishes for subscription. After the dry run of 10 November 2026: 53 items in 120 days, none matched to a listing already on the guide; the bingo and trivia nights, book clubs, the weekly jazz and barbecue, a retirement party and a business mixer are excluded by title, which leaves about 30: named music at Loveland Aleworks, the Festival of Lights, Flip the Switch, the holiday concerts and markets, the Historical Society programs. This calendar lists other organizers' events and is filed as chamber, so its items wait for a person. autoApprove from 10 November 2026, the owner's word (asked whether this board should publish as Eventbrite does: "yes, publish those too"): its items publish under the standing rules, and one that may be an event already on the guide at that hour still waits.

sources.name: Crooked Beech Brewing (taproom events calendar)
sources.defaultVenue: Crooked Beech Brewing, 3121 N Garfield Ave, Loveland
sources.notes: Found and read 10 November 2026. Crooked Beech Brewing, 3121 N. Garfield Ave., Loveland (the address is the guide's own place listing; the brewery's events page, built on Webador, does not print it). The page embeds a public Google Calendar titled "Crooked Beech Brewing Taproom Events"; the public iCal for that id answered 200 with 399 VEVENTs running to September 2027. 27 single items are dated 10 November to 10 December 2026, plus weekly and monthly repeats. Worth a row, 7: Folking Imposters (14 November, 6 pm), the Sound Affects Music Fundraiser (15 November), Wendy Woo (27 November, 7 pm), Social Dancing Lessons with Santa (2 December), Next Stop Comedy (4 December), Christine Alice (5 December) and a Santa Visit (6 December). The brewery's own site has no robots rule against its pages. Confirmed 10 November 2026 on the owner's word ("Go 1 to 3", DECISIONS.md, "Twenty-four sources turned on"): robots: subscribe from the same day, the owner's call: the host's robots.txt disallows the path, and this is the calendar the organization publishes for subscription; one weekly read is what a subscribed calendar does.

sources.name: Centerra (community events: Chapungu, Kinston, the Promenade area)
sources.notes: Found and read 10 November 2026. WordPress with its own events pages and month archives (/events/2026/11/, /events/2026/12/), no Events Calendar REST route and no iCal found, so it is a page a person reads; robots.txt disallows only /wp-admin/. The November and December archives were read. Regulars: Peaks, Pours and Playlists (live music Fridays 4 to 7 pm and Sundays 1:30 to 4:30 pm, acts not named on the list), a monthly trivia night, music bingo, and the High Plains Environmental Center's garden club, nature journaling and children's series, which the center's own calendar carries. sources.name: Verboten Brewing & Barrel Project (events)
sources.defaultVenue: Verboten Brewing & Barrel Project, 127 E 5th St, Loveland
sources.notes: Found and read 10 November 2026. Verboten Brewing and Barrel Project, 127 E. 5th St., Loveland (printed on each event). WordPress with Modern Events Calendar Lite. Its iCal export (?mec-ical-feed=1) returns the home page, but the events archive has an RSS feed whose items carry the event's date in pubDate and in mec:startDate, the hours in mec:startHour and mec:endHour, and the address in mec:location; robots.txt allows it. College Ave., "Verboten Brewing North"), which the location filter must drop; ingest's RSS reader may not read the mec: fields, so test before turning it on. The events page lists 17 occurrences for 10 to 30 November 2026. Worth a row, 3: Verboten's Acoustic Afternoons with Derek Dames Ohl (16 November, 3 to 5 pm), Edward Cohen (23 November) and the Warner Parker Duo (30 November). Check these by hand first: the site dates all three on Mondays at 3 pm, and the trivia titled for first and third Tuesdays is dated Wednesday 11 November, so the calendar's dates may be a day off. Regulars: trivia, Monday poker, Shut Up and Write. December was not listed yet.

sources.name: Loveland Orchestra (season)
sources.notes: Found and read 10 November 2026. The Loveland Orchestra, a community orchestra that plays at Mountain View High School (3500 Mountain Lion Dr.), Thompson Valley High School and, in summer, the Foundry Plaza downtown. WordPress; no Events Calendar REST route. The page's own "add all events to your calendar" link is a static iCal file the orchestra uploaded in August 2026 (14 VEVENTs, the season's concerts), recorded here as the feed; it is a file, not a live calendar, so a rescheduled concert may not reach it and next season's file will have a new address. The events page prints the whole season as plain HTML and robots.txt allows it. One concert is dated 10 November to 10 December 2026: Our Winter Wishes (4 December, talk 7 pm, concert 7:30 pm, Mountain View High School: Ellington's Nutcracker Suite, Tchaikovsky's Swan Lake, Respighi). Then Our Mozart Melodies (29 January 2027) and Our Mahler Masterpiece (12 March 2027). Five or six dates a year, so a monthly look is enough.

It is the gallery's working calendar: of about 39 items dated 10 November to 31 December 2026, most are the names of whoever is staffing the gallery that day ("Bransin Tidwell", "Bransin Gallery"), plus a directors' meeting, an art drop-off and closures. Worth a row between 10 November and 10 December, 3: the Small Works Show opening (17 November) and two workshops, Beneath the Sea Zentangle (15 November, 1 pm) and Let's Decorate Fused Glass Ornaments (29 November, 1 pm). sources.name: Eventbrite, events in Loveland
sources.notes: Proposed 10 November 2026, when the owner asked for a way to use Eventbrite. The place page is Eventbrite's search of the region around Loveland, not of the town: 49 pages of twenty.
